name: pi-chat
description: A local-first Web/PWA client for Pi RPC

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:katex && tsx watch src/server/index.ts --dev
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:identity && npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run copy:resources && npm run build:pi-runtime
scripts.test: npm run test:source-and-benchmark && npm run test:artifact
scripts.test:source:single-process: node scripts/run-tests.mjs --exclude-file tests/application-restart.test.ts --exclude-file tests/build-guard.test.ts --exclude-file tests/e2e-fixtures.test.ts --exclude-file tests/e2e-runtime-dist.test.ts --exclude-file tests/pi-runtime-build.test.ts --exclude-file tests/pi-runtime-bundle.test.ts --exclude-file tests/startup-smoke.test.ts --exclude-file tests/web-build-artifacts.test.ts --exclude-file tests/windows-launcher.test.ts --exclude-file tests/browser-fluency-benchmark.test.ts --exclude-file tests/e2e-streaming-benchmark.test.ts --exclude-file tests/long-session-benchmark.test.ts --exclude-file tests/react-render-benchmark.test.ts --exclude-file tests/streaming-cadence-benchmark.test.ts
scripts.test:source-and-benchmark: npm run test:source && npm run test:benchmark
scripts.test:artifact: node scripts/run-tests.mjs --file tests/application-restart.test.ts --file tests/build-guard.test.ts --file tests/e2e-fixtures.test.ts --file tests/e2e-runtime-dist.test.ts --file tests/pi-runtime-build.test.ts --file tests/pi-runtime-bundle.test.ts --file tests/startup-smoke.test.ts --file tests/web-build-artifacts.test.ts --file tests/windows-launcher.test.ts
scripts.build-and-test:artifact: npm run build && npm run test:artifact
scripts.verify:source-and-e2e: npm run build && npm run test:source-and-benchmark && npm run test:e2e:prebuilt
